国家地区选项与一级行政区联动。: Country selection linked to first-level subdivisions.
国际区号选项与本地号码输入。: Calling code selection with local phone number input.
省、市、区县级联选择与行政区信息。: Province, city and district selection with administrative details.
按需加载 GeoJSON，并使用 ECharts 展示和下钻。: Load GeoJSON on demand and explore maps with ECharts.
导入入口、语言配置、通用数据约定与数据元信息。: Entry points, locale configuration, shared conventions and data metadata.
将 getCountryOptions 的选项直接用于选择器，切换语言查看本地化: Use getCountryOptions in a selector and switch languages to see localized names.
通过 loadGeoJSON 异步加载地图，注册到 ECharts 并支持切换地: Load maps asynchronously with loadGeoJSON, register them in ECharts and switch maps or languages.
选择区县以查看 adcode 和中心坐标: Select a district to view its adcode and center coordinates
可通过上方选择器或点击地图下钻；无下级边界的地区显示本级轮廓: Use the selector or click the map to drill down. Regions without child boundaries show their own outlines.
当前地图没有可下钻的区域: This map has no regions available for drill-down.
选择行政区以查看节点信息: Select an administrative division to view node details
切换语言可重新本地化已导入的 JSON，无需重新加载地图。: Switch languages to localize the imported JSON again without reloading the map.
使用二位码、三位码或数字码查询国家，并处理未知代码。: Look up countries by alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric code and handle unknown codes.
查询共享同一区号的全部地区；区号不能唯一确定地区。: Find all regions sharing a calling code; a calling code does not uniquely identify a region.
切换省市区深度，并在选项树上添加 chinaAreaTree 的国家根节点。: Switch selection depth and add the country root from chinaAreaTree to the option tree.
列出地图、检查动态 ID、直接导入并本地化 JSON，查看随包发布的元信息。: List maps, check dynamic IDs, import and localize JSON directly, and inspect bundled metadata.
输入二位码、三位码或数字码，如 CN / CHN / 156: Enter alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric code, e.g. CN / CHN / 156
输入国际区号，如 1 或 86: Enter a calling code, e.g. 1 or 86
输入地图 ID，如 CN-provinces / US: Enter a map ID, e.g. CN-provinces / US
使用 getCountryOptions() 获取平铺国家选项，不按洲分组；切换: Use getCountryOptions() for flat country options without continent groups; switch languages to see localized names.
使用 getGroupedCountryOptions() 获取按洲分组的国家选: Use getGroupedCountryOptions() for country options grouped by continent, then getSubdivisions(countryCode) for linked first-level subdivisions.
切换页面语言，国家名称自动更新，不需要手动刷新。: Country names update automatically when you switch the page language. No manual refresh is needed.
切换语言后，下拉选项和已选国家的名称会自动切换，国家代码保持不变。: Switch languages to update the country options and selected country name automatically; the country code stays the same.
按洲选择国家，再选择省或州: Choose a country by continent, then a province or state
选择国际区号并输入号码: Select a calling code and enter a number
选择到省、市或区县: Choose province, city or district depth
点击地图查看下一级: Click a map to explore child regions
检查地图是否存在与切换名称语言: Check map availability and switch name languages
选择一个国家，查看它的名称和代码；下拉列表不按洲分组。: Choose a country to see its name and code. The options are not grouped by continent.
先从按洲分组的列表里选国家，再选择该国的省或州；换国家后会清空原来的省或州。: Choose a country from continent groups, then choose its province or state. Changing the country clears the previous subdivision.
输入 CN、CHN 或 156 都能查到中国；输入不存在的代码会显示“未找到”。: Enter CN, CHN or 156 to find China. Unknown codes show a “not found” message.
切换页面的中英文，国家名称会自动跟着变，选中的国家不会变，也不用点刷新。: Switch the page language and country names update automatically. Your selected country stays the same, with no refresh needed.
选择电话地区后显示对应区号，再输入本地号码；列表按洲分组，常用地区放在最前面。: Select a phone region to see its calling code, then enter a local number. Options are grouped by continent, with common regions first.
输入 +1 查看共用这个区号的所有地区，输入 +86 查看中国；找不到时显示空结: Enter +1 to see all regions sharing that calling code, or +86 for China. Unknown calling codes show an empty result.
依次选择省、市、区县，查看所选地区的行政区代码和中心坐标。: Choose a province, city and district to see its administrative code and center coordinates.
切换选择范围：只选省、选到市或选到区县；也可以让列表从“中国”开始。: Choose how far the selector goes: province, city or district. You can also start the list with “China”.
选择世界、中国省级或美国地图后自动加载；切换中英文，地图上的名称也会更新。: Select the world, China provinces or United States map to load it automatically. Map names also update when you switch languages.
点击有下级地图的地区继续查看，用“返回上一级”返回；颜色、标记和次数都是演示数据: Click a region with a child map to explore it, then use “Go back” to return. Colors, markers and counts are sample data.
输入地图 ID 检查是否有数据；下方用中国省级地图对比切换语言前后的名称，并展示: Enter a map ID to check availability. Below, compare names from the China provinces JSON across languages and inspect its data version and sources.
下面固定展示中国省级地图的名称；切换页面语言后右侧名称自动更新，上方 ID 只用: The comparison below always uses China provinces. The names on the right update automatically with the page language; the ID above only checks map availability.
以中国省级地图的 3 个区域为例，对照原始名称与当前语言的名称。: Compare original and localized names for three regions in the China province map.
直接导入 JSON，保留原始名称。: Direct JSON imports preserve the original names.
根据当前页面语言生成独立副本。: Create a separate copy in the current page language.
区域代码保持不变，仅转换名称。: Region codes stay the same; only names are localized.
输入地图 ID，检查是否收录对应地图；此处不影响上方的名称示例。: Enter a map ID to check availability. This does not change the name example above.
对照原始数据与本地化结果，切换中英文观察名称变化；也可独立检查地图 ID 是否可: Compare original and localized data, then switch languages to see names change. Check map availability separately.
坐标顺序为经度、纬度。行政中心为省会／首府、市或区县驻地等；几何中心反映区域形状: Coordinates are listed as longitude, latitude. The administrative center represents a provincial capital or an administrative seat at city or district level; the geometric center reflects the area’s shape. Both use DataV coordinates, with missing values shown independently.
选择区县以查看 adcode、行政中心和几何中心坐标: Select a district to view its adcode, administrative center and geometric center coordinates
依次选择省、市、区县，分别查看所选地区的行政中心坐标和几何中心坐标。: Choose a province, city and district to see its administrative center and geometric center coordinates separately.
